mutations.label: host-review: a result without a findings array is not a review
mutations.only: ^(?:a host result missing the schema is unavailable, and the host is told the target)$

mutations.label: host-review: the host is told the repository and scope
mutations.only: ^(?:a host result missing the schema is unavailable, and the host is told the target)$

mutations.label: host-review: a missing cursor agent is not a clean review
mutations.from: if (!bin) return unavailable('cursor', null, 'cursor agent binary is absent', model)
mutations.to: if (!bin) return { status: 'clean', host: 'cursor', model, effort: null, bound: 'reported', findings: [], reason: '' }
mutations.only: ^(?:a host review is the schema or unavailable)$
